patch_list: Block analytics & tracking
Stops the app's analytics, attribution, and audience-measurement services.
Block installed-app scan
Stops the app from checking which other apps are on your phone and reporting them.
Disable auto-updates
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Disable NewsBreak AI
Turns off the Nia AI chat and the Scout reading assistant.
GmsCore support
Signs in with Google through GmsCore instead of Google Play services.
Hide AI summaries
Hides the AI-written summary card on crime and local-alert pages.
Hide device identifiers
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Hide My Town intro
Removes the "Meet My Town" pop-up, the My Town tooltip, and the tab's "new" badge.
Hide Premium upsells
Removes the "Ad-free Reading" banners, Upgrade buttons, and Premium offers. Leave it off if you pay for Premium.
Hide rating prompt
Removes the "How are we doing?" pop-up and the Play Store rating request.
Hide VPN connection
Hides an active VPN from the app's checks on the phone.
Report Wi-Fi connection
Makes the app see a Wi-Fi connection when the phone is on mobile data.
Route traffic through a proxy
Sends the app's network traffic through a proxy you choose, such as Orbot or a VPN service's SOCKS5 server.
Skip ads
Removes the ads in the feed, the app-open and full-screen ads, and the ads in articles.
Spoof carrier
Hides your mobile carrier from the app, or reports a carrier name you choose.
